scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply $(grep 'database_name' wrangler.toml | head -1 | sed 's/.*database_name = "\(.*\)"/\1/') --local
scripts.db:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply $(grep 'database_name' wrangler.toml | head -1 | sed 's/.*database_name = "\(.*\)"/\1/') --remote
scripts.vectorize:create: wrangler vectorize create $(grep 'index_name' wrangler.toml | head -1 | sed 's/.*index_name = "\(.*\)"/\1/') --dimensions=768 --metric=cosine
